Hi all — did a quick pass on the numbers Avery provided. Putting the assumptions up front and then the results (pilot and scaled):

Assumptions (conservative):
- MAU pilot: 50,000 -> prod: 200,000
- Sessions per MAU / month: 4
- Avg tokens per session: 600 (prompt + output)
- Nightly embeddings: 10% of sessions, 1,200 tokens per embedding call
- Our landed inference cost (model + infra): $6 / 1M tokens (conservative internal cost)
- Redwood list price scenarios: $18 / 1M (low), $30 / 1M (mid), $45 / 1M (high premium)

Quick math (production scenario = 200k MAU):
- Monthly sessions = 200k * 4 = 800k sessions
- Tokens for chat = 800k * 600 = 480,000,000 tokens (480M)
- Embeddings = 800k * 10% * 1,200 = 96,000,000 tokens (96M)
- Total tokens / month = 576M tokens

Costs and revenue (per 1M token basis):
- Our landed cost: $6 / 1M -> monthly landed cost = 576 * $6 = $3,456
- At Redwood list = $18 / 1M -> invoice = 576 * $18 = $10,368 -> gross margin = $6,912 (67%)
- At Redwood list = $30 / 1M -> invoice = 576 * $30 = $17,280 -> gross margin = $13,824 (80%)
- At Redwood list = $45 / 1M -> invoice = 576 * $45 = $25,920 -> gross margin = $22,464 (87%)

Per-feature unit costs (using $30 /1M as an example list price):
- Effective price per token = $30 / 1,000,000 = $0.00003 per token
- Chat event (600 tokens): cost to customer = 600 * $0.00003 = $0.018 -> ~1.8 cents per event
- End-of-session summary (400 tokens): cost = 400 * $0.00003 = $0.012 -> 1.2 cents per summary
- Embedding call (1,200 tokens): cost = 1,200 * $0.00003 = $0.036 -> 3.6 cents per embedding

Monthly example for chat-only feature (production):
- Chat events = 800k -> cost to customer @ $30 = 800k * $0.018 = $14,400 (this aligns with Avery's $30 target producing ~ $14.4k/month)
- Our landed cost portion for those tokens = 800k * 600 tokens = 480M tokens -> landed cost = 480 * $6 = $2,880

Margin & CAC payback implications:
- If FintechX prices the feature as an add-on and captures $3 ARPU / user / month from the feature:
  - Revenue (prod) = 200k * $3 = $600k / month (note: ARPU assumptions for whole product, not just inference)
  - Inference invoice @ $30/1M = $17,280 (small % of revenue) -> inference is not the primary margin driver here
  - With CAC $300, payback = CAC / monthly gross contribution. If contribution margin after non-inference costs is ~$30/user/year then payback will be in the 6–12 month range. We should model more detailed ARPU/CAC splits separately.

Recommendations for proposal and pilot:
1) Offer a 3-month pilot price at $18 / 1M for up to 100M tokens (gives them breathing room vs their $10k–$20k budget) and then tiered list price at $30 /1M above threshold.
2) Provide per-feature cost table (we'll show cost/event and monthly totals) so their product team can map to ARPU and feature pricing.
3) Align on quantization/Model family for pilot (we should propose an optimized open model with our $6/1M landed cost assumption).
4) Run CAC/payback sensitivity matrix during the next call — Neha can help with packaging and monetization strategy.

I’ve populated the attached template with the above scenarios and included a one-page summary you can send to FintechX. Marissa — want me to join the vendor review next week for the unit-econ call?

Thanks,
